String.string:
[EN] A New Breed
[ES] Una nueva raza
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'll talk to him."
[ES] "Hablaré con él."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Okay."
[ES] "Está bien."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] See Lauma in Frontera.
[ES] Busca a Lauma en Frontera.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Kechalku? Got it."
[ES] "¿Kechalku? Entendido."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Meet with Grunath at the Feral Valley Station.
[ES] Reúnete con Grunath en Feral Valley Station.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I understand."
[ES] "Entiendo".
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Meet Kechaku at the Experior Outpost in Feral Valley.
[ES] Reúnete con Kechaku en Experior Outpost, en Feral Valley.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Climb the cliff near the Arena of Blood and fight the gula executors.
[ES] Trepa por el risco cerca de Arena of Blood y combate a los verdugos gula.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Lair, flute. Okay."
[ES] "Guarida, flauta. De acuerdo."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Report to Paduk of the Emissary Point in the Feral Valley that the gula executors have been killed.
[ES] Informa a Paduk, en Emissary Point (Feral Valley), de que los verdugos gula han sido aniquilados.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Find the secret cave entrance near the Arena of Blood. Go to the meeting point, then use the summoning flute.
[ES] Busca la entrada secreta a la cueva cerca de Arena of Blood. Ve al punto de encuentro y usa la flauta de invocación.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] This Graatush must be the contact.
[ES] Este Graatush tiene que ser el contacto.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "That doesn't sound quite right...."
[ES] "Eso no suena del todo bien..."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Get information from Graatush.
[ES] Consigue información de Graatush.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Badoask's Head
[ES] Cabeza de Badoask
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Kill Badoask in the Arena of Blood. Take his head.
[ES] Mata a Badoask en Arena of Blood. Quédate con su cabeza.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Take Badoask's head to Karba at Emissary Point.
[ES] Lleva la cabeza de Badoask a Karba en Emissary Point.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "He won't escape!"
[ES] ¡No escapará!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Vadrask's Head
[ES] Cabeza de Vadrask
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Kill Vadrask and bring back his head.
[ES] Mata a Vadrask y trae su cabeza de vuelta.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Take Vadrask's head to Karba at Emissary Point.
[ES] Lleva la cabeza de Vadrask a Karba en Emissary Point.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'll do it."
[ES] "Lo haré."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Karba the Revered
[ES] Karba el Venerado
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Karba's Letter
[ES] Carta de Karba
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Deliver Karba's letter to Lauma in Frontera.
[ES] Entrega la carta de Karba a Lauma en Frontera.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "If you say so..."
[ES] "Si tú lo dices..."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
